task.title: Create a first profile from the Library
task.shortdesc: Start a new Guided profile draft from the Library when no saved profile is suitable to reuse.

prereq.p: You are in the Library and want a new profile rather than opening or duplicating an existing one.

context.p: The create action opens a Guided editor draft. The draft becomes a saved profile only after you save it.

step.cmd: Choose the Library action to create a new profile.

info.p: Expected result: BPM opens the Guided editor for a new draft.

step.cmd: Choose the profile purpose, schema channel, and starter options shown by the editor.

info.p: The schema channel affects available controls and validation behavior.

step.cmd: Save the draft when it has the name and initial settings you want.

info.note: Closing an unsaved draft can lose draft-only changes.

result.p: The new profile is saved and can be found again from the Library.

postreq.p: Recovery: if you meant to reuse an existing profile, cancel the draft and duplicate the saved profile instead.
